notes: Existing VARCO generation results were downloaded; this tool does not generate or upload assets.
Project contains prepared lightweight FBX and 2K color/normal maps. Original high-resolution downloads remain outside Assets in tmp.
Bounds-based size and orientation are layout proposals; seam, UV and apparent scale still need visual review.
4m modules are repeated; final 3m wall/floor/ceiling pieces have a .75 length scale.
Only visual renderers were changed. Existing collision, player setup and gameplay limitations remain.
The fire-door visual is on the locked B4 boundary only. Airlock open door placeholders retain their prior logic state.
Pump and cabinet visuals have no collider or gameplay interaction. No bridging surface was added over the cooling pit.
No other floor, Build Settings, SampleScene or existing Sign_ object was changed.
